s1.title: Create your shop
s1.body: Sign up with your email and name your shop. It takes a minute.

s2.title: Add your products
s2.body: Enter what you sell, your prices and how many you have.

s3.title: Start selling
s3.body: Record sales, receive stock and track debts. Your reports fill in by themselves.

offline.a: Yes. Once you've signed in on a phone, you can record sales, receive stock and take debt payments with no internet at all. Everything is saved on the phone and sent to the cloud automatically when the connection comes back.

safe.a: Your records are stored securely in the cloud and backed up, so losing a phone doesn't mean losing your books. Each shop's data is kept completely separate, and every action is recorded in an activity log that nobody can edit or delete.

cashier.q: Can my cashier see my profit?
cashier.a: No. Cashiers can record sales and debt payments, but they never see cost prices, profit or stock value. Managers and owners can.

phone.q: Can I use it on my phone?
phone.a: Yes, StockWise was designed for phones first. Open it in your browser and tap "Add to home screen" to install it like an app. It also works on tablets and computers.

computer.a: No. A smartphone is enough to run your whole shop. A computer is handy for reports, but not required.

vat.a: Yes. If your shop is registered for VAT, switch it on in Settings. VAT is added to the products you mark, and your TPIN is shown on receipts.

staff.q: My staff don't have email. Can they still use it?
staff.a: Yes. The owner or a manager can create a login with a username and password for them, and reset it any time.

pricing.q: What happens when early access ends?
pricing.a: We'll tell you well in advance before any paid plans start. Your data stays yours, and early users keep a discount.
